commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin || exit 41
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-datasets-qa.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
export WORK
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 --single-branch https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
actual="$(git -C "$WORK/source" rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$actual" = 56eb04f31760316a1d6ad8988a2f1cc0583827d6 || { echo 'RESEARCH_SHA_CHANGED'; exit 42; }
printf 'SOURCE_SHA|%s\n' "$actual"
cd "$WORK/source"
python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_external_greenhouse_benchmark
echo 'EXTERNAL_DATA_UNITTEST|PASS'
python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import urlopen,Request
from pathlib import Path
import os
base='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SmartGreenHouses/NUTRICONTROL_datasets/6dece0d2c7483982610e4d2de225db3c4649b935/'
sources=[
 ('alava','Alava_data/clean_data/Alava_15min.csv'),
 ('cartagena_comp0','Cartagena_data/clean_data/Cartagena_comp0_15min.csv'),
 ('navarra_comp0','Navarra_data/clean_data/Navarra_comp0_15min.csv')
]
for site,path in sources:
 target=Path(os.environ['WORK'])/(site+'.csv')
 with urlopen(Request(base+path,headers={'User-Agent':'BloomML-public-data-benchmark'}),timeout=45) as stream,target.open('wb') as f:
  while True:
   chunk=stream.read(1024*1024)
   if not chunk:break
   f.write(chunk)
   if f.tell()>25_000_000:raise ValueError('dataset too large')
 print('PINNED_DATA_DOWNLOAD|'+site+'|'+str(target.stat().st_size))
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tools.ml.external_greenhouse_benchmark import evaluate_file
import json,os
expected={
 'alava':'20873873821550b73b9afe95a364c9ac8c572d325143befcd0885650212e3fbd',
 'cartagena_comp0':'b68e5b84d79085236719fb9d9536a0ae5b48ce0ffd15ed3d1cb978bcd248c29c',
 'navarra_comp0':'6ea4aa27dbf1786ca791688b5d9090aa363fcc5f77b795844931d6e8188a85a8'}
for site,sha in expected.items():
 r=evaluate_file(Path(os.environ['WORK'])/(site+'.csv'),site,expected_sha256=sha)
 selected={'site':site,'rows':r['rows'],'first_source_time':r['first_source_time'],
           'last_source_time':r['last_source_time'],'sha256':r['source_sha256'],
           'clock_basis':r['clock_basis'],'holdout_day':r['holdout_cutoff_local_naive_day'],
           'completeness':r['completeness_fraction'],'actuator_nonmissing':r['actuator_nonmissing_counts'],
           'baseline':r['baseline'],'warnings':r['warnings']}
 print('REAL_BLOOMML_DATASET_BASELINE_JSON|'+json.dumps(selected,separators=(',',':')))
 assert r['physical_model_calibrated'] is False
 assert r['training_approval']=='NOT_APPROVED_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN'
print('NUTRICONTROL_REAL_SAMPLES_BASELINE|PASS')
PY
echo 'BLOOMML_DATASET_AUDIT_ALL_DONE'
